# Domain schema dag/v0

Like `graph/v0`, with no cycles: steps, stages, job or build order. The engine rejects cycles. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/dag/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/dag/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/dag/v0.json).

An extraction in this schema is an [extraction](extraction.md) whose `schema` is `dag/v0`; the extraction schema applies this one
to it.

## Typed data

No typed `data` fields: every `data` field is open JSON.
